# California well permit activity

> A free web app that tracks approved California oil and gas well permits from public CalGEM WellSTAR data, updated
> weekly. Built by Ryan Weller ([ryweller.com](https://ryweller.com)).

## What it shows

- Approved well permits by operator, parent company, field, county, and CalGEM district.
- Work activity: New Drill, Existing (work on existing wells), and Abandonment. Functional well type: producer, thermal producer, injector, observation, and other.
- Weekly approved permits by work activity, and a since-last-week summary.
- Kern County New Drill permits vs. the SB 237 annual cap, with operator-reported spuds from the CalGEM Central District Drill Tracker.
- A map of permits over CalGEM field boundaries, and permit records with CSV export and links to each well's WellSTAR detail page.
- Filters are stored in the URL, so a filtered view can be shared as a link.

## Pages

- [California well permit activity](https://permits.ryweller.com/): the permit explorer
- [About / methodology](https://permits.ryweller.com/about-methodology/): data sources, definitions, and limitations

## Data sources

- [WellSTAR Notices](https://gis.conservation.ca.gov/server/rest/services/WellSTAR/Notices/MapServer/1): permits
- [WellSTAR Wells](https://gis.conservation.ca.gov/server/rest/services/WellSTAR/Wells/MapServer/0): well location, type, and status
- [CalGEM field boundaries](https://gis.conservation.ca.gov/server/rest/services/CalGEM/Admin_Bounds/MapServer/0)
- [CalGEM Central District Drill Tracker](https://www.conservation.ca.gov/calgem/Documents/Permits/Central%20District%20Drill%20Tracker.xlsx): Kern spud dates
- [Baker Hughes rig count](https://rigcount.bakerhughes.com/na-rig-count): weekly California and Kern rigs

Counts are approved permits, not wells drilled. CalGEM is the authoritative source for any single permit.
